rule: game-lines desk probability + passing desk verdict + DraftKings price, pre-game only
note: No pre-game alerts: an alert needs a game-lines-desk probability whose verdict passed (not NO EDGE / UNPROVEN) and a DraftKings price. NBA: 5 desk verdict NO EDGE; NHL: 12 desk verdict NO EDGE; WNBA: 1 not pre-game; MLS: 2 no validated model probability (not from the game-lines desk); EPL: 6 started or no start time; UCL: 9 no validated model probability (not from the game-lines desk); NFL: 12 desk verdict UNPROVEN; NCAAF: 13 started or no start time; NCAAB: 6 not pre-game; CWS: 1 not pre-game
